description: This file contains utility functions for shader compilation, including reading shader files, compiling shaders, linking programs, and handling shader source code for different shader types and versions within the ANGLE project.

methods.name: ReadEntireFile
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file into a string buffer.

methods.name: CompileProgramInternal
methods.description: Compiles vertex, geometry, and fragment shaders, attaches them to a program, and links it.

methods.name: CompileShader
methods.description: Compiles a shader of a given type from source code.

methods.name: CompileShaderFromFile
methods.description: Reads shader source from a file and compiles it.

methods.name: CheckLinkStatusAndReturnProgram
methods.description: Checks if a program linked successfully, outputs errors if requested, and returns the program.

methods.name: CompileProgram
methods.description: Compiles a program from vertex and fragment source strings.

methods.name: CompileProgramWithGS
methods.description: Compiles a program with vertex, geometry, and fragment shaders.

methods.name: CompileProgramFromFiles
methods.description: Reads shader sources from files and compiles a program.

methods.name: LoadBinaryProgramOES
methods.description: Loads a binary program using the OES extension.

methods.name: LoadBinaryProgramES3
methods.description: Loads a binary program for ES3.

methods.name: LinkAttachedProgram
methods.description: Links a program and checks its status.
